226                                SANSKRIT GRAMMAR.                 [§ 366

आ-'up to, towards, all round, a little,' &c.; आच्छादृ 'to cover
        all round,' आकारः 'form or shape (within due bounds),
        आकारः' 'that which shines all round' i. e. 'the ether';
        आकम्प 'to shake a little,' &c.

उद्-द्-'upon,' &c.; उद्गम् 'to go up,' उद्यमः 'industry,' उत्सर्गः
        'pouring out, hence a gift, a general rule,' &c.

उप-'near to, towards, by the side of,' &c.; उपगा 'to go near
        to,' उपकृति f. 'an obligation,' उपरति f. 'death,' उपस्थानं
        'praise, worship,' उपमिति f. 'comparison,' &c.

दुस्-स्-'bad, hard to be done,' &c.; दुराचारः 'bad conduct,' दुष्कर
        'hard to be done,' दुःसह 'difficult to be borne,' &c.

नि-'in, into, great, opposed to,' &c.; निड् 'to insult,' निकेत 'a
        house,' निचय 'a heap, a great collection,' निपीत 'drunk
        in,' निदेश 'a command,' &c.

निर्-र्-'out of, away from, without,' &c.; निःसृ 'to issue out,'
        निर्गम 'a passage out,' निर्दोषः 'out of i. e. free from
        blame,' निः संक 'without doubt,' &.

परा-'away, back, opposed to,' &c.; पराकृ 'to reject, to despise,'
        पराक्रम 'to act bravely,' परागत 'gone away,' पराजृ 'turn
        back,' पराजय 'what is opposed to victory, defeat,' &c.

परि-'all round, about,' &c.; परिधा 'to place all round i. e. to put
        on or wear,' परिधिः 'a wall &c. that surrounds,' परिणामः
        'ripening, maturity,' परिगणना 'counting all round, i. e.
        a complete enumeration,' &c.

प्रति-'towards, back, in return, in opposition to,' &c.; प्रतिगम्
        'to go towards,' प्रतिभाषण 'a speech in return, an ans-
        wer,' प्रति-वि-कारः 'an act in opposition to i. e.
        a remedy' &c.
